newsitem.title: PERU: Seven found alive after boat overturns in Peru.
newsitem.headline: Seven found alive after boat overturns in Peru.

text.p: Seven of nine people missing and feared drowned when an excursion boat capsized over the weekend in rough seas off Peru's southern coast were found alive after swimming to a beach, authorities said on Monday.
The "Zodiac" capsized on Saturday off Pisco, 150 miles (240 kms) south of Lima, Pisco port Capt. Carlos Arias-Perez Egana told Reuters.
He said after clinging to the overturned boat for almost five hours, the nine passengers - five children and four adults from three families - decided to swim for shore, some 200 yards (meters) away.
"Unfortunately, only seven made it," he said.
